news.headline: IESC: IES Holdings reports 17 holdings worth $288.9M at Sept 30
IES Holdings expected to report fiscal Q4 results around Nov 20; consensus EPS about $2.81
news.summary: Market calendars project the fiscal Q4/FY2026 report for about November 20 with consensus EPS near $2.81, but IES has not yet confirmed the date. Last year it announced the schedule on November 14 and reported on November 21 before the open.

news.headline: A Look at IES Holdings Inc (IESC) After 8.8% Gain
news.summary: IESC shares rose 8.8% in one session shortly after hitting a 52-week low on Nov 4, recovering part of the recent drawdown ahead of fiscal Q4 results.

news.headline: IES Holdings shares fall sharply, hit 52-week low near $170
news.summary: IESC dropped by double digits on Nov 4 and touched a new 52-week low around $170, extending the selloff that began after the debt-funded DBM Global deal closed. The move came amid broad weakness in AI data-center infrastructure names.

news.headline: IES Holdings (IESC) Stock May Be 19% Below Fair Value On Cash Flow
news.summary: A discounted cash flow model puts IESC about 19% below its estimated fair value after the October pullback. The analysis also notes the higher leverage from the debt-funded DBM Global deal.

news.headline: IES Holdings Ups Borrowing Capacity to $700 Million With Wells Fargo-Led Amended Credit Facility
news.summary: IES amended its credit agreement into a $200M term loan plus a $500M revolver, totaling $700M. It drew $525M to help fund the DBM Global purchase.

news.headline: IES Holdings Completes Acquisition of DBM Global
news.summary: IES closed the roughly $691M acquisition of steel fabricator and erector DBM Global from INNOVATE, paid mostly in cash plus IES shares. DBM becomes a new Structural segment.

catalysts.label: Fiscal Q4 / FY2026 results
catalysts.detail: Calendars project about November 20 (consensus EPS about $2.81); not yet confirmed by IES, which last year announced the date a week ahead and reported before the open. Focus: FY2027 outlook, backlog, data-center demand in Communications, and first color on DBM Global integration and leverage.

catalysts.label: Fiscal Q1 2027 results (first quarter with DBM Global)
catalysts.detail: The first full quarter consolidating the new Structural segment and the $525M of acquisition debt.

pulse: IES is now a larger, more leveraged company after closing the roughly $691M DBM Global acquisition, funded largely with $525M of new borrowings. The stock sold off through October, hit a 52-week low near $170 on Nov 4, then bounced with an 8.8% one-day gain; no new company releases or analyst actions have appeared since. As of Nov 13 IES still has not confirmed the date of its fiscal Q4/FY2026 report; aggregators expect about Nov 20 with roughly $2.81 EPS, and the release should give the first FY2027 outlook including the new Structural segment.
